critique.missing_from_policy_prompt_for_memory: When several new goal-color detections are appended to arrivals in one step, the instruction did not say in what order to append them. Here two new green cubes appeared within this step: [86, 143] first at t=64 and [86, 95] first at t=112. The last frame lists them as [86, 95], [86, 143] (sorted by x), and I appended in that listed order. The instruction should state: append new detections in the order of the execution frame in which each first appeared (earliest frame first), tracking each across frames within about 12 px, and only fall back to the last frame's listed order (or ascending y) when two appear in the same frame. That gives [[86, 143], [86, 95]].

The arrivals rule's release-echo test says 'within about 12 px of the gripper in the frame the fingers opened' without saying which frame that is. Here the fingers went 93% at t=160 (gripper [91, 166], 16 px from the detection) and 100% at t=176 (gripper [82, 164], under 9 px from the new detection at [80, 168]). I took the first opening frame and so did not exclude [75, 169]. The instruction should say the echo test uses the first frame where the fingers are about 100% open (and nothing is held), and that a goal-color detection that first appears in that frame within about 12 px of the gripper and then drifts a few px with the retreating arm (here [80, 168] -> [75, 169] while the gripper moved [82, 164] -> [61, 159]) is a release echo and is never appended to arrivals, even though it is far from the bin center.
